fields.content: Discover a wide selection of premium mouth fresheners and mukhwas. Our luxurious products combine classic and modern flavors, made with top-quality ingredients for a refreshing experience.

fields.content: Discover Surili Mukhwas' bestsellers: Classic Pan Supari Fusion, Spicy Minty Saunf Elixir, Tangy Imli Goli Temptation, Royal Anardana Mix, Spicy Adrak Dhaniya Crunch, Saffron Pistachio Symphony, and Sweet Caramelized Elaichi Bliss. Enjoy these flavorful treats!

fields.content: Our Sugar-Free Healthy Mukhwas is a refreshing blend of roasted seeds, natural mint, and citrus zest, designed to promote digestion and freshen breath without added sugars. Conveniently packaged, it's perfect for post-meal freshness or an anytime snack.

fields.name: Mukhwas
fields.content: Discover a unique post-meal experience with Surili's heterogeneous spice mix. This selection of authentic Indian seeds and spices enhances its rich aroma, creating a delightful mukhwas with a blend of harmonious flavors.

fields.content: Surili's churan is a testament to our dedication to traditional recipes and high-quality ingredients. Experience the therapeutic benefits of our finely crafted churan, promoting digestive wellness.

fields.name: Pan
fields.content: Explore the unique essence of pan mukhwas from Surili, meticulously crafted to capture the authentic flavor of pan leaves. Enjoy a burst of freshness and cultural richness in every bite.

fields.name: Tiny Miny

fields.name: Digestive Mukhwas
fields.about: Digestive Mukhwas is a type of mouth freshener specifically formulated to aid digestion. It typically contains ingredients known for their digestive properties, such as fennel seeds, anise seeds, coriander seeds, and ajwain (carom seeds). This blend helps to soothe the stomach and promote healthy digestion after meals.
fields.footer: Disclaimer For 9kg, 18kg, 27kg: Please note that our 9kg, 18kg, and 27kg products will be delivered in individual 1kg air-tight plastic bags, with 9, 18, or 27 (1kg each individual packaging) packs respectively. For GST bills, feel free to contact us via text at 9750000393.
